Adaptability.short: This Pokemon's same-type attack bonus (STAB) is 2 instead of 1.5.
Adaptability.desc: This Pokemon's moves that match one of its types have a same-type attack bonus (STAB) of 2 instead of 1.5.

Aerilate.short: This Pokemon's Normal-type moves become Flying type and have 1.2× power.
Aerilate.desc: This Pokemon's Normal-type moves become Flying-type moves and have their power multiplied by 1.2. This effect comes after other effects that change a move's type, but before Ion Deluge and Electrify's effects.

Aftermath.short: If this Pokemon is KOed with a contact move, that move's user loses 1/4 its max HP.
Aftermath.desc: If this Pokemon is knocked out with a contact move, that move's user loses 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down. This effect is prevented if the move's user has the Magic Guard Ability or if any active Pokemon has the Damp Ability.

Air Lock.short: While this Pokemon is active, the effects of weather conditions are disabled.

Analytic.short: This Pokemon's attacks have 1.3× power if it is the last to move in a turn.
Analytic.desc: The power of this Pokemon's move is multiplied by 1.3 if it is the last to move in a turn. Does not affect Doom Desire and Future Sight.

Anger Point.short: If this Pokemon (not its substitute) takes a critical hit, its Attack is raised 12 stages.
Anger Point.desc: If this Pokemon, but not its substitute, is struck by a critical hit, its Attack is raised by 12 stages.

Anger Shell.short: At 1/2 or less of this Pokemon's max HP: +1 Atk, Sp. Atk, Spe, and -1 Def, Sp. Def.
Anger Shell.desc: When this Pokemon has more than 1/2 its maximum HP and takes damage from an attack bringing it to 1/2 or less of its maximum HP, its Attack, Special Attack, and Speed are raised by 1 stage, and its Defense and Special Defense are lowered by 1 stage. This effect applies after all hits from a multi-hit move. This effect is prevented if the move had a secondary effect removed by the Sheer Force Ability.

Anticipation.short: On switch-in, this Pokemon shudders if any foe has a supereffective or OHKO move.
Anticipation.desc: On switch-in, this Pokemon is alerted if any opposing Pokemon has an attacking move with a type that is super effective against this Pokemon, or any OHKO move. This effect considers Hidden Power to be its determined type, and every other move to be its original type.

Arena Trap.short: Prevents opposing Pokemon from choosing to switch out unless they are airborne.
Arena Trap.desc: Prevents opposing Pokemon from choosing to switch out unless they are airborne, are holding a Shed Shell, or are a Ghost type.

Armor Tail.short: This Pokemon and its allies are protected from opposing priority moves.
Armor Tail.desc: Priority moves used by opposing Pokemon targeting this Pokemon or its allies are prevented from having an effect.

Aroma Veil.short: Protects user/allies from Attract, Disable, Encore, Heal Block, Taunt, and Torment.
Aroma Veil.desc: This Pokemon and its allies cannot become affected by Attract, Disable, Encore, Heal Block, Taunt, or Torment.

As One (Glastrier).short: Combination of the Unnerve and Chilling Neigh Abilities.

As One (Spectrier).short: Combination of the Unnerve and Grim Neigh Abilities.

Aura Break.short: While this Pokemon is active, the Dark Aura and Fairy Aura power modifier is 0.75×.
Aura Break.desc: While this Pokemon is active, the effects of the Dark Aura and Fairy Aura Abilities are reversed, multiplying the power of Dark- and Fairy-type moves, respectively, by 3/4 instead of 1.33.

Aura Guard.short: This Pokemon receives 1/2 damage from contact moves.

Bad Dreams.short: Causes sleeping foes to lose 1/8 of their max HP at the end of each turn.
Bad Dreams.desc: Causes opposing Pokemon to lose 1/8 of their maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn if they are asleep.

Battery.short: This Pokemon's allies have the power of their special attacks multiplied by 1.3.

Battle Armor.short: This Pokemon cannot be struck by a critical hit.

Battle Bond.short: After KOing a Pokemon: raises Attack, Sp. Atk, Speed by 1 stage. Once per battle.
Battle Bond.desc: If this Pokemon is a Greninja, its Attack, Special Attack, and Speed are raised by 1 stage if it attacks and knocks out another Pokemon. This effect can only happen once per battle.

Beads of Ruin.short: Active Pokemon without this Ability have their Special Defense multiplied by 0.75.

Beast Boost.short: This Pokemon's highest stat is raised by 1 if it attacks and KOes another Pokemon.
Beast Boost.desc: This Pokemon's highest stat is raised by 1 stage if it attacks and knocks out another Pokemon. Stat stage changes are not considered. If multiple stats are tied, Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed are prioritized in that order.

Berserk.short: This Pokemon's Sp. Atk is raised by 1 when it reaches 1/2 or less of its max HP.
Berserk.desc: When this Pokemon has more than 1/2 its maximum HP and takes damage from an attack bringing it to 1/2 or less of its maximum HP, its Special Attack is raised by 1 stage. This effect applies after all hits from a multi-hit move. This effect is prevented if the move had a secondary effect removed by the Sheer Force Ability.

Big Pecks.short: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's Defense stat stage.

Blaze.short: At 1/3 or less of its max HP, this Pokemon's offensive stat is 1.5× with Fire attacks.
Blaze.desc: When this Pokemon has 1/3 or less of its maximum HP, rounded down, its offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Fire-type attack.

Bulletproof.short: This Pokemon is immune to bullet moves.

Cheek Pouch.short: If this Pokemon eats a Berry, it restores 1/3 of its max HP after the Berry's effect.
Cheek Pouch.desc: If this Pokemon eats a held Berry, it restores 1/3 of its maximum HP, rounded down, in addition to the Berry's effect. This effect can also activate after the effects of Bug Bite, Fling, Pluck, Stuff Cheeks, and Teatime if the eaten Berry had an effect on this Pokemon.

Chilling Neigh.short: This Pokemon's Attack is raised by 1 stage if it attacks and KOes another Pokemon.
Chilling Neigh.desc: This Pokemon's Attack is raised by 1 stage if it attacks and knocks out another Pokemon.

Chlorophyll.short: If Sun is active, this Pokemon's Speed is doubled.
Chlorophyll.desc: If Sun is active, this Pokemon's Speed is doubled. This effect is prevented if this Pokemon is holding a Utility Umbrella.

Clear Body.short: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's stat stages.

Cloud Nine.short: While this Pokemon is active, the effects of weather conditions are disabled.

Color Change.short: This Pokemon's type changes to the type of a move it's hit by, unless it has the type.
Color Change.desc: This Pokemon's type changes to match the type of the last move that hit it, unless that type is already one of its types. This effect applies after all hits from a multi-hit move. This effect is prevented if the move had a secondary effect removed by the Sheer Force Ability.

Comatose.short: This Pokemon cannot be statused, and is considered to be asleep.
Comatose.desc: This Pokemon is considered to be asleep and cannot become affected by a non-volatile status condition or Yawn.

Commander.short: If ally is Dondozo: this Pokemon cannot act or be hit, +2 to all Dondozo's stats.
Commander.desc: If this Pokemon is a Tatsugiri and a Dondozo is an active ally, this Pokemon goes into the Dondozo's mouth. The Dondozo has its Attack, Special Attack, Speed, Defense, and Special Defense raised by 2 stages. During the effect, the Dondozo cannot be switched out, this Pokemon cannot select an action, and attacks targeted at this Pokemon will be avoided but it will still take indirect damage. If this Pokemon faints during the effect, a Pokemon can be switched in as a replacement but the Dondozo remains unable to be switched out. If the Dondozo faints during the effect, this Pokemon regains the ability to select an action.

Competitive.short: This Pokemon's Sp. Atk is raised by 2 for each of its stats that is lowered by a foe.
Competitive.desc: This Pokemon's Special Attack is raised by 2 stages for each of its stat stages that is lowered by an opposing Pokemon.

Compound Eyes.short: This Pokemon's moves have their accuracy multiplied by 1.3.

Contrary.short: If this Pokemon has a stat stage raised it is lowered instead, and vice versa.

Corrosion.short: This Pokemon can poison or badly poison a Pokemon regardless of its typing.

Costar.short: On switch-in, this Pokemon copies all of its ally's stat stage changes.

Cotton Down.short: If this Pokemon is hit, it lowers the Speed of all other Pokemon on the field 1 stage.
Cotton Down.desc: When this Pokemon is hit by an attack, the Speed of all other Pokemon on the field is lowered by 1 stage.

Cud Chew.short: If this Pokemon eats a Berry, it will eat that Berry again at the end of the next turn.

Curious Medicine.short: On switch-in, this Pokemon's allies have their stat stages reset to 0.

Cursed Body.short: If this Pokemon is hit by an attack, there is a 30% chance that move gets disabled.
Cursed Body.desc: If this Pokemon is hit by an attack, there is a 30% chance that move gets disabled unless one of the attacker's moves is already disabled.

Cute Charm.short: 30% chance of infatuating Pokemon of the opposite gender if they make contact.
Cute Charm.desc: There is a 30% chance a Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon will become infatuated if it is of the opposite gender.

Damp.short: Prevents Explosion/Mind Blown/Misty Explosion/Self-Destruct/Aftermath while active.
Damp.desc: While this Pokemon is active, Explosion, Mind Blown, Misty Explosion, Self-Destruct, and the Aftermath Ability are prevented from having an effect.

Dancer.short: After another Pokemon uses a dance move, this Pokemon uses the same move.
Dancer.desc: After another Pokemon uses a dance move, this Pokemon uses the same move. The copied move is subject to all effects that can prevent a move from being executed. A move used through this Ability cannot be copied again by other Pokemon with this Ability.

Dark Aura.short: While this Pokemon is active, a Dark move used by any Pokemon has 1.33× power.
Dark Aura.desc: While this Pokemon is active, the power of Dark-type moves used by active Pokemon is multiplied by 1.33.

Dauntless Shield.short: On switch-in, this Pokemon's Defense is raised by 1 stage. Once per battle.

Dazzling.short: This Pokemon and its allies are protected from opposing priority moves.
Dazzling.desc: Priority moves used by opposing Pokemon targeting this Pokemon or its allies are prevented from having an effect.

Defeatist.short: While this Pokemon has 1/2 or less of its max HP, its Attack and Sp. Atk are halved.
Defeatist.desc: While this Pokemon has 1/2 or less of its maximum HP, its Attack and Special Attack are halved.

Defiant.short: This Pokemon's Attack is raised by 2 for each of its stats that is lowered by a foe.
Defiant.desc: This Pokemon's Attack is raised by 2 stages for each of its stat stages that is lowered by an opposing Pokemon.

Delta Stream.short: On switch-in, strong winds begin until this Ability is not active in battle.
Delta Stream.desc: On switch-in, the weather becomes Strong Winds, which removes the weaknesses of the Flying type from Flying-type Pokemon. This weather remains in effect until this Ability is no longer active for any Pokemon, or the weather is changed by the Desolate Land or Primordial Sea Abilities.

Desolate Land.short: On switch-in, extremely harsh sunlight begins until this Ability is not active in battle.
Desolate Land.desc: On switch-in, the weather becomes Intense Sun, which includes all the effects of Sun and prevents damaging Water-type moves from executing. This weather remains in effect until this Ability is no longer active for any Pokemon, or the weather is changed by the Delta Stream or Primordial Sea Abilities.

Disguise.short: (Mimikyu only) The first hit it takes is blocked, and it takes 1/8 HP damage instead.
Disguise.desc: If this Pokemon is a Mimikyu, the first hit it takes in battle deals 0 neutral damage. Its disguise is then broken, it changes to Busted Form, and it loses 1/8 of its max HP. Confusion damage also breaks the disguise.

Download.short: On switch-in, Attack or Sp. Atk is raised 1 stage based on the foes' weaker Defense.
Download.desc: On switch-in, this Pokemon's Attack or Special Attack is raised by 1 stage based on the weaker combined defensive stat of all opposing Pokemon. Attack is raised if their Defense is lower, and Special Attack is raised if their Special Defense is the same or lower.

Dragon's Maw.short: This Pokemon's offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Dragon-type attack.

Dragonize.short: This Pokemon's Normal-type moves become Dragon type and have 1.2× power.
Dragonize.desc: This Pokemon's Normal-type moves become Dragon-type moves and have their power multiplied by 1.2. This effect comes after other effects that change a move's type, but before Ion Deluge and Electrify's effects.

Drizzle.short: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Rain.

Drought.short: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Sun.

Dry Skin.short: This Pokemon is healed 1/4 by Water, 1/8 by Rain; is hurt 1.25× by Fire, 1/8 by Sun.
Dry Skin.desc: This Pokemon is immune to Water-type moves and restores 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down, when hit by a Water-type move. The power of Fire-type moves is multiplied by 1.25 when used on this Pokemon. At the end of each turn, this Pokemon restores 1/8 of its maximum HP, rounded down, if the weather is Rain, and loses 1/8 of its maximum HP, rounded down, if the weather is Sun. The weather effects are prevented if this Pokemon is holding a Utility Umbrella.

Early Bird.short: This Pokemon's sleep counter drops by 2 instead of 1.

Earth Eater.short: This Pokemon heals 1/4 of its max HP when hit by Ground moves; Ground immunity.
Earth Eater.desc: This Pokemon is immune to Ground-type moves and restores 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down, when hit by a Ground-type move.

Eelevate.short: This Pokemon is immune to Ground; +1 to highest stat if it KOes another Pokemon.
Eelevate.desc: This Pokemon is immune to Ground-type attacks and the effects of Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Sticky Web, and the Arena Trap Ability. The effects of Gravity, Ingrain, Smack Down, Thousand Arrows, and Iron Ball nullify the immunity. Thousand Arrows can hit this Pokemon as if it did not have this Ability. This Pokemon's highest stat is raised by 1 stage if it attacks and knocks out another Pokemon. Stat stage changes are not considered. If multiple stats are tied, Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed are prioritized in that order.

Effect Spore.short: 30% chance of poison/paralysis/sleep on others making contact with this Pokemon.
Effect Spore.desc: 30% chance a Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon will be poisoned, paralyzed, or fall asleep.

Electric Surge.short: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Electric Terrain.

Electromorphosis.short: This Pokemon gains the Charge effect when it takes a hit from an attack.

Embody Aspect (Cornerstone).short: On switch-in, this Pokemon's Defense is raised by 1 stage.

Embody Aspect (Hearthflame).short: On switch-in, this Pokemon's Attack is raised by 1 stage.

Embody Aspect (Teal).short: On switch-in, this Pokemon's Speed is raised by 1 stage.

Embody Aspect (Wellspring).short: On switch-in, this Pokemon's Special Defense is raised by 1 stage.

Emergency Exit.short: This Pokemon switches out when it reaches 1/2 or less of its maximum HP.
Emergency Exit.desc: When this Pokemon has more than 1/2 its maximum HP and takes damage bringing it to 1/2 or less of its maximum HP, it immediately switches out to a chosen ally. This effect applies after all hits from a multi-hit move. This effect is prevented if the move had a secondary effect removed by the Sheer Force Ability. This effect applies to both direct and indirect damage, except Curse and Substitute on use, Belly Drum, Pain Split, and confusion damage.

Fairy Aura.short: While this Pokemon is active, a Fairy move used by any Pokemon has 1.33× power.
Fairy Aura.desc: While this Pokemon is active, the power of Fairy-type moves used by active Pokemon is multiplied by 1.33.

Filter.short: This Pokemon receives 3/4 damage from supereffective attacks.

Fire Mane.short: This Pokemon's offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Fire-type attack.

Flame Body.short: 30% chance a Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon will be burned.

Flare Boost.short: While this Pokemon is burned, its special attacks have 1.5× power.
Flare Boost.desc: While this Pokemon is burned, the power of its special attacks is multiplied by 1.5.

Flash Fire.short: This Pokemon's Fire attacks do 1.5× damage if hit by one Fire move; Fire immunity.
Flash Fire.desc: This Pokemon is immune to Fire-type moves. The first time it is hit by a Fire-type move, its offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Fire-type attack as long as it remains active and has this Ability. If this Pokemon is frozen, it cannot be defrosted by Fire-type attacks.

Flower Gift.short: If user is Cherrim and Sun is active, it and allies' Attack and Sp. Def are 1.5×.
Flower Gift.desc: If this Pokemon is a Cherrim and Sun is active, it changes to Sunshine Form and the Attack and Special Defense of it and its allies are multiplied by 1.5. These effects are prevented if the Pokemon is holding a Utility Umbrella.

Flower Veil.short: This side's Grass types can't have stats lowered or status inflicted by other Pokemon.
Flower Veil.desc: Grass-type Pokemon on this Pokemon's side cannot have their stat stages lowered by other Pokemon or have a non-volatile status condition inflicted on them by other Pokemon.

Fluffy.short: This Pokemon takes 1/2 damage from contact moves, 2× damage from Fire moves.
Fluffy.desc: This Pokemon receives 1/2 damage from contact moves, but double damage from Fire moves.

Forecast.short: Castform's type changes to the current weather condition's type, except Sandstorm.
Forecast.desc: If this Pokemon is a Castform, its type changes to the current weather condition's type, except Sandstorm. This effect is prevented if this Pokemon is holding a Utility Umbrella and the weather is Rain or Sun.

Forewarn.short: On switch-in, this Pokemon is alerted to the foes' move with the highest power.
Forewarn.desc: On switch-in, this Pokemon is alerted to the move with the highest power, at random, known by an opposing Pokemon. This effect considers OHKO moves to have 150 power, Counter, Mirror Coat, and Metal Burst to have 120 power, every other attacking move with an unspecified power to have 80 power, and non-damaging moves to have 1 power.

Friend Guard.short: This Pokemon's allies receive 3/4 damage from other Pokemon's attacks.

Frisk.short: On switch-in, this Pokemon identifies the held items of all opposing Pokemon.

Full Metal Body.short: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's stat stages.

Gale Wings.short: If this Pokemon is at full HP, its Flying-type moves have their priority increased by 1.

Galvanize.short: This Pokemon's Normal-type moves become Electric type and have 1.2× power.
Galvanize.desc: This Pokemon's Normal-type moves become Electric-type moves and have their power multiplied by 1.2. This effect comes after other effects that change a move's type, but before Ion Deluge and Electrify's effects.

Gluttony.short: This Pokemon eats Berries at 1/2 max HP or less instead of their usual 1/4 max HP.
Gluttony.desc: When this Pokemon is holding a Berry that usually activates with 1/4 or less of its maximum HP, it is eaten at 1/2 or less of its maximum HP instead.

Good as Gold.short: This Pokemon is immune to Status moves.

Gooey.short: Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon have their Speed lowered by 1 stage.

Gorilla Tactics.short: This Pokemon's Attack is 1.5×, but it can only select the first move it executes.
Gorilla Tactics.desc: This Pokemon's Attack is multiplied by 1.5, but it can only select the first move it executes. These effects are prevented while this Pokemon is Dynamaxed.

Grass Pelt.short: If Grassy Terrain is active, this Pokemon's Defense is multiplied by 1.5.

Grassy Surge.short: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Grassy Terrain.

Grim Neigh.short: This Pokemon's Sp. Atk is raised by 1 stage if it attacks and KOes another Pokemon.
Grim Neigh.desc: This Pokemon's Special Attack is raised by 1 stage if it attacks and knocks out another Pokemon.

Guard Dog.short: Immune to Intimidate. Intimidated: +1 Attack. Cannot be forced to switch out.
Guard Dog.desc: This Pokemon is immune to the effect of the Intimidate Ability and raises its Attack by 1 stage instead. This Pokemon cannot be forced to switch out by another Pokemon's attack or item.

Gulp Missile.short: When hit after Surf/Dive, attacker takes 1/4 max HP and -1 Defense or paralysis.
Gulp Missile.desc: If this Pokemon is a Cramorant, it changes forme when it hits a target with Surf or uses the first turn of Dive successfully. It becomes Gulping Form with an Arrokuda in its mouth if it has more than 1/2 of its maximum HP remaining, or Gorging Form with a Pikachu in its mouth if it has 1/2 or less of its maximum HP remaining. If Cramorant gets hit in Gulping or Gorging Form, it spits the Arrokuda or Pikachu at its attacker, even if it has no HP remaining. The projectile deals damage equal to 1/4 of the target's maximum HP, rounded down; this damage is blocked by the Magic Guard Ability but not by a substitute. An Arrokuda also lowers the target's Defense by 1 stage, and a Pikachu paralyzes the target. Cramorant will return to normal if it spits out a projectile, switches out, or Dynamaxes.

Guts.short: If this Pokemon is statused, its Attack is 1.5×; ignores burn halving physical damage.
Guts.desc: If this Pokemon has a non-volatile status condition, its Attack is multiplied by 1.5. This Pokemon's physical attacks ignore the burn effect of halving damage.

Hadron Engine.short: On switch-in, summons Electric Terrain. During Electric Terrain, Sp. Atk is 1.3333×.

Harvest.short: If last item used is a Berry, 50% chance to restore it each end of turn. 100% in Sun.
Harvest.desc: If the last item this Pokemon used is a Berry, there is a 50% chance it gets restored at the end of each turn. If Sun is active, this chance is 100%.

Healer.short: 30% chance this Pokemon's ally has its status cured at the end of each turn.
Healer.desc: 30% chance this Pokemon's ally has its non-volatile status condition cured at the end of each turn.

Heatproof.short: Fire damage against this Pokemon is dealt with 1/2 offensive stat; 1/2 burn damage.
Heatproof.desc: If a Pokemon uses a Fire-type attack against this Pokemon, that Pokemon's offensive stat is halved when calculating the damage to this Pokemon. This Pokemon takes half of the usual burn damage, rounded down.

Heavy Metal.desc: This Pokemon's weight is doubled. This effect is calculated after the effect of Autotomize, and before the effect of Float Stone.

Hospitality.short: On switch-in, this Pokemon restores 1/4 of its ally's maximum HP, rounded down.

Hunger Switch.short: If Morpeko, it changes between Full Belly and Hangry Mode at the end of each turn.
Hunger Switch.desc: If this Pokemon is a Morpeko, it changes formes between its Full Belly Mode and Hangry Mode at the end of each turn.

Hustle.short: This Pokemon's Attack is 1.5× and accuracy of its physical attacks is 0.8×.
Hustle.desc: This Pokemon's Attack is multiplied by 1.5 and the accuracy of its physical attacks is multiplied by 0.8.

Hydration.short: This Pokemon has its status cured at the end of each turn if Rain is active.
Hydration.desc: This Pokemon has its non-volatile status condition cured at the end of each turn if Rain is active. This effect is prevented if this Pokemon is holding a Utility Umbrella.

Hyper Cutter.short: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's Attack stat stage.

Ice Body.short: If Snow is active, this Pokemon heals 1/16 of its max HP each turn.
Ice Body.desc: If Snow is active, this Pokemon restores 1/16 of its maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn.

Ice Face.short: If Eiscue, the first physical hit it takes deals 0 damage. Effect is restored in Snow.
Ice Face.desc: If this Pokemon is an Eiscue, the first physical hit it takes in battle deals 0 neutral damage. Its ice face is then broken and it changes forme to Noice Face. Eiscue regains its Ice Face forme when Snow begins or when Eiscue switches in while Snow is active. Confusion damage also breaks the ice face.

Ice Scales.short: This Pokemon receives 1/2 damage from special attacks.

Illuminate.short: This Pokemon's accuracy can't be lowered by others; ignores their evasiveness stat.
Illuminate.desc: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's accuracy stat stage. This Pokemon ignores a target's evasiveness stat stage.

Illusion.short: This Pokemon appears as the last Pokemon in the party until it takes direct damage.
Illusion.desc: When this Pokemon switches in, it appears as the last unfainted Pokemon in its party until it takes direct damage from another Pokemon's attack. This Pokemon's actual level and HP are displayed instead of those of the mimicked Pokemon.

Immunity.short: This Pokemon cannot be poisoned. Gaining this Ability while poisoned cures it.

Imposter.short: On switch-in, this Pokemon Transforms into the opposing Pokemon that is facing it.
Imposter.desc: On switch-in, this Pokemon Transforms into the opposing Pokemon that is facing it. If there is no Pokemon at that position, this Pokemon does not Transform.

Infiltrator.short: Moves ignore substitutes and foe's Reflect/Light Screen/Safeguard/Mist/Aurora Veil.
Infiltrator.desc: This Pokemon's moves ignore substitutes and the opposing side's Reflect, Light Screen, Safeguard, Mist, and Aurora Veil.

Innards Out.short: If this Pokemon is KOed with a move, that move's user loses an equal amount of HP.
Innards Out.desc: If this Pokemon is knocked out with a move, that move's user loses HP equal to the amount of damage inflicted on this Pokemon.

Inner Focus.short: This Pokemon cannot be made to flinch. Immune to Intimidate.
Inner Focus.desc: This Pokemon cannot be made to flinch. This Pokemon is immune to the effect of the Intimidate Ability.

Insomnia.short: This Pokemon cannot fall asleep. Gaining this Ability while asleep cures it.

Intimidate.short: On switch-in, this Pokemon lowers the Attack of opponents by 1 stage.
Intimidate.desc: On switch-in, this Pokemon lowers the Attack of opposing Pokemon by 1 stage. Pokemon with the Inner Focus, Oblivious, Own Tempo, or Scrappy Abilities and Pokemon behind a substitute are immune.

Intrepid Sword.short: On switch-in, this Pokemon's Attack is raised by 1 stage. Once per battle.

Iron Barbs.short: Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon lose 1/8 of their max HP.
Iron Barbs.desc: Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon lose 1/8 of their maximum HP, rounded down.

Iron Fist.short: This Pokemon's punch-based attacks have 1.2× power. Sucker Punch is not boosted.
Iron Fist.desc: This Pokemon's punch-based attacks have their power multiplied by 1.2.

Justified.short: This Pokemon's Attack is raised by 1 stage after it is damaged by a Dark-type move.

Keen Eye.short: This Pokemon's accuracy can't be lowered by others; ignores their evasiveness stat.
Keen Eye.desc: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's accuracy stat stage. This Pokemon ignores a target's evasiveness stat stage.

Klutz.short: This Pokemon's held item has no effect, except Macho Brace. Fling cannot be used.
Klutz.desc: This Pokemon's held item has no effect. This Pokemon cannot use Fling successfully. Macho Brace, Power Anklet, Power Band, Power Belt, Power Bracer, Power Lens, and Power Weight still have their effects.

Leaf Guard.short: If Sun is active, this Pokemon cannot be statused and Rest will fail for it.
Leaf Guard.desc: If Sun is active, this Pokemon cannot become affected by a non-volatile status condition or Yawn, and Rest will fail for it. This effect is prevented if this Pokemon is holding a Utility Umbrella.

Levitate.short: This Pokemon is immune to Ground; Gravity/Ingrain/Smack Down/Iron Ball nullify it.
Levitate.desc: This Pokemon is immune to Ground-type attacks and the effects of Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Sticky Web, and the Arena Trap Ability. The effects of Gravity, Ingrain, Smack Down, Thousand Arrows, and Iron Ball nullify the immunity. Thousand Arrows can hit this Pokemon as if it did not have this Ability.

Libero.short: This Pokemon's type changes to the type of the move it is using. Once per switch-in.
Libero.desc: This Pokemon's type changes to match the type of the move it is about to use. This effect comes after all effects that change a move's type. This effect can only happen once per switch-in, and only if this Pokemon is not Terastallized.

Light Metal.desc: This Pokemon's weight is halved, rounded down to a tenth of a kilogram. This effect is calculated after the effect of Autotomize, and before the effect of Float Stone. A Pokemon's weight will not drop below 0.1 kg.

Lightning Rod.short: This Pokemon draws Electric moves to itself to raise Sp. Atk by 1; Electric immunity.
Lightning Rod.desc: This Pokemon is immune to Electric-type moves and raises its Special Attack by 1 stage when hit by an Electric-type move. If this Pokemon is not the target of a single-target Electric-type move used by another Pokemon, this Pokemon redirects that move to itself if it is within the range of that move. If multiple Pokemon could redirect with this Ability, it goes to the one with the highest Speed, or in the case of a tie to the one that has had this Ability active longer.

Limber.short: This Pokemon cannot be paralyzed. Gaining this Ability while paralyzed cures it.

Lingering Aroma.short: Making contact with this Pokemon has the attacker's Ability become Lingering Aroma.
Lingering Aroma.desc: Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon have their Ability changed to Lingering Aroma. Does not affect Pokemon with the As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Lingering Aroma, Multitype, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero Abilities.

Liquid Ooze.short: This Pokemon damages those draining HP from it for as much as they would heal.

Liquid Voice.short: This Pokemon's sound-based moves become Water type.
Liquid Voice.desc: This Pokemon's sound-based moves become Water-type moves. This effect comes after other effects that change a move's type, but before Ion Deluge and Electrify's effects.

Long Reach.short: This Pokemon's attacks do not make contact with the target.

Magic Bounce.short: This Pokemon blocks certain Status moves and bounces them back to the user.
Magic Bounce.desc: This Pokemon is unaffected by certain non-damaging moves directed at it and will instead use such moves against the original user. Moves reflected in this way are unable to be reflected again by this or Magic Coat's effect. Spikes, Stealth Rock, Sticky Web, and Toxic Spikes can only be reflected once per side, by the leftmost Pokemon under this or Magic Coat's effect. The Lightning Rod and Storm Drain Abilities redirect their respective moves before this Ability takes effect.

Magic Guard.short: This Pokemon can only be damaged by direct attacks.
Magic Guard.desc: This Pokemon can only be damaged by direct attacks. Curse and Substitute on use, Belly Drum, Pain Split, Struggle recoil, and confusion damage are considered direct damage.

Magician.short: If this Pokemon has no item, it steals the item off a Pokemon it hits with an attack.
Magician.desc: If this Pokemon has no item, it steals the item off a Pokemon it hits with an attack. Does not affect Doom Desire and Future Sight. If multiple targets are hit by an attack the item is stolen from the fastest Pokemon, while considering the effect of Trick Room and prioritizing opposing Pokemon before allies.

Magma Armor.short: This Pokemon cannot be frozen. Gaining this Ability while frozen cures it.

Magnet Pull.short: Prevents opposing Steel-type Pokemon from choosing to switch out.
Magnet Pull.desc: Prevents opposing Steel-type Pokemon from choosing to switch out, unless they are holding a Shed Shell or are a Ghost type.

Marvel Scale.short: If this Pokemon has a non-volatile status condition, its Defense is multiplied by 1.5.

Mega Launcher.short: This Pokemon's pulse moves have 1.5× power. Heal Pulse heals 3/4 target's max HP.
Mega Launcher.desc: This Pokemon's pulse moves have their power multiplied by 1.5. Heal Pulse restores 3/4 of a target's maximum HP, rounded half down.

Mega Sol.short: This Pokemon's moves are used as if the effects of Sun were active.

Merciless.short: This Pokemon's attacks are critical hits if the target is poisoned.

Mimicry.short: This Pokemon's types change to match the Terrain. Type reverts when Terrain ends.
Mimicry.desc: This Pokemon's types change to match the active Terrain when this Pokemon acquires this Ability, or whenever a Terrain begins. Electric type during Electric Terrain, Grass type during Grassy Terrain, Fairy type during Misty Terrain, and Psychic type during Psychic Terrain. If this Ability is acquired without an active Terrain, or a Terrain ends, this Pokemon's types become the original types for its species.

Mind's Eye.short: Fighting, Normal moves hit Ghost. Accuracy can't be lowered, ignores evasiveness.
Mind's Eye.desc: This Pokemon can hit Ghost types with Normal- and Fighting-type moves. Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's accuracy stat stage. This Pokemon ignores a target's evasiveness stat stage.

Minus.short: If an active ally has this Ability or the Plus Ability, this Pokemon's Sp. Atk is 1.5×.
Minus.desc: If an active ally has this Ability or the Plus Ability, this Pokemon's Special Attack is multiplied by 1.5.

Mirror Armor.short: If this Pokemon's stat stages would be lowered, the attacker's are lowered instead.
Mirror Armor.desc: When one of this Pokemon's stat stages would be lowered by another Pokemon, that Pokemon's stat stage is lowered instead. This effect does not happen if this Pokemon's stat stage was already -6. If the other Pokemon has a substitute, neither Pokemon has its stat stage lowered.

Misty Surge.short: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Misty Terrain.

Mold Breaker.short: This Pokemon's moves and their effects ignore the Abilities of other Pokemon.
Mold Breaker.desc: This Pokemon's moves and their effects ignore certain Abilities of other Pokemon. The Abilities that can be negated are Armor Tail, Aroma Veil, Aura Break, Battle Armor, Big Pecks, Bulletproof, Clear Body, Contrary, Damp, Dazzling, Disguise, Dry Skin, Earth Eater, Filter, Flash Fire, Flower Gift, Flower Veil, Fluffy, Friend Guard, Fur Coat, Good as Gold, Grass Pelt, Guard Dog, Heatproof, Heavy Metal, Hyper Cutter, Ice Face, Ice Scales, Illuminate, Immunity, Inner Focus, Insomnia, Keen Eye, Leaf Guard, Levitate, Light Metal, Lightning Rod, Limber, Magic Bounce, Magma Armor, Marvel Scale, Mind's Eye, Mirror Armor, Motor Drive, Multiscale, Oblivious, Overcoat, Own Tempo, Pastel Veil, Punk Rock, Purifying Salt, Queenly Majesty, Sand Veil, Sap Sipper, Shell Armor, Shield Dust, Simple, Snow Cloak, Solid Rock, Soundproof, Sticky Hold, Storm Drain, Sturdy, Suction Cups, Sweet Veil, Tangled Feet, Telepathy, Tera Shell, Thermal Exchange, Thick Fat, Unaware, Vital Spirit, Volt Absorb, Water Absorb, Water Bubble, Water Veil, Well-Baked Body, White Smoke, Wind Rider, Wonder Guard, and Wonder Skin. This affects every other Pokemon on the field, whether or not it is a target of this Pokemon's move, and whether or not their Ability is beneficial to this Pokemon.

Moody.short: Boosts a random stat (except accuracy/evasion) +2 and another stat -1 every turn.
Moody.desc: This Pokemon has a random stat, other than accuracy or evasiveness, raised by 2 stages and another stat lowered by 1 stage at the end of each turn.

Motor Drive.short: This Pokemon's Speed is raised 1 stage if hit by an Electric move; Electric immunity.
Motor Drive.desc: This Pokemon is immune to Electric-type moves and raises its Speed by 1 stage when hit by an Electric-type move.

Mountaineer.short: On switch-in, this Pokemon avoids all Rock-type attacks and Stealth Rock.

Moxie.short: This Pokemon's Attack is raised by 1 stage if it attacks and KOes another Pokemon.
Moxie.desc: This Pokemon's Attack is raised by 1 stage if it attacks and knocks out another Pokemon.

Multiscale.short: If this Pokemon is at full HP, damage taken from attacks is halved.

Multitype.short: If this Pokemon is an Arceus, its type changes to match its held Plate.

Mummy.short: Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon have their Ability changed to Mummy.
Mummy.desc: Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon have their Ability changed to Mummy. Does not affect Pokemon with the As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Multitype, Mummy, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero Abilities.

Mycelium Might.short: This Pokemon's Status moves go last in their priority bracket and ignore Abilities.
Mycelium Might.desc: This Pokemon's Status moves ignore certain Abilities of other Pokemon, and go last among Pokemon using the same or greater priority moves.

Natural Cure.short: This Pokemon has its non-volatile status condition cured when it switches out.

Neuroforce.short: This Pokemon's attacks that are super effective against the target do 1.25× damage.
Neuroforce.desc: This Pokemon's attacks that are super effective against the target have their damage multiplied by 1.25.

Neutralizing Gas.short: While this Pokemon is active, Abilities have no effect.
Neutralizing Gas.desc: While this Pokemon is active, Abilities have no effect. This Ability activates before hazards and other Abilities take effect. Does not affect the As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero Abilities.

No Guard.short: Every move used by or against this Pokemon will always hit.

Normalize.short: This Pokemon's moves are changed to be Normal type and have 1.2× power.
Normalize.desc: This Pokemon's moves are changed to be Normal type and have their power multiplied by 1.2. This effect comes before other effects that change a move's type.

Oblivious.short: This Pokemon cannot be infatuated or taunted. Immune to Intimidate.
Oblivious.desc: This Pokemon cannot be infatuated or taunted. Gaining this Ability while infatuated or taunted cures it. This Pokemon is immune to the effect of the Intimidate Ability.

Opportunist.short: When an opposing Pokemon has a stat stage raised, this Pokemon copies the effect.

Orichalcum Pulse.short: On switch-in, summons Sun. During Sun, Attack is 1.3333×.

Overcoat.short: This Pokemon is immune to powder moves, Sandstorm damage, and Effect Spore.
Overcoat.desc: This Pokemon is immune to powder moves, damage from Sandstorm, and the effects of Rage Powder and the Effect Spore Ability.

Overgrow.short: At 1/3 or less of its max HP, this Pokemon's offensive stat is 1.5× with Grass attacks.
Overgrow.desc: When this Pokemon has 1/3 or less of its maximum HP, rounded down, its offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Grass-type attack.

Own Tempo.short: This Pokemon cannot be confused. Immune to Intimidate.
Own Tempo.desc: This Pokemon cannot be confused. Gaining this Ability while confused cures it. This Pokemon is immune to the effect of the Intimidate Ability.

Parental Bond.short: This Pokemon's damaging moves hit twice. The second hit has its damage quartered.
Parental Bond.desc: This Pokemon's damaging moves become multi-hit moves that hit twice. The second hit has its damage quartered. Does not affect Doom Desire, Dragon Darts, Dynamax Cannon, Endeavor, Explosion, Final Gambit, Fling, Future Sight, Ice Ball, Rollout, Self-Destruct, any multi-hit move, any move that has multiple targets, or any two-turn move.

Pastel Veil.short: This Pokemon and its allies cannot be poisoned. On switch-in, cures poisoned allies.
Pastel Veil.desc: This Pokemon and its allies cannot be poisoned. Gaining this Ability while this Pokemon or its ally is poisoned cures them. If this Ability is being ignored during an effect that causes poison, this Pokemon is cured immediately but its ally is not.

Perish Body.short: Making contact with this Pokemon starts the Perish Song effect for it and the attacker.
Perish Body.desc: Making contact with this Pokemon starts the Perish Song effect for it and the attacker. This effect does not happen for this Pokemon if the attacker already has a perish count.

Persistent.short: When used, Gravity/Heal Block/Safeguard/Tailwind/Room effects last 2 more turns.
Persistent.desc: The duration of Gravity, Heal Block, Magic Room, Safeguard, Tailwind, Trick Room, and Wonder Room is increased by 2 turns if the effect is started by this Pokemon.

Pickpocket.short: If this Pokemon has no item and is hit by a contact move, it steals the attacker's item.
Pickpocket.desc: If this Pokemon has no item and is hit by a contact move, it steals the attacker's item. This effect applies after all hits from a multi-hit move. This effect is prevented if the move had a secondary effect removed by the Sheer Force Ability.

Pickup.short: If this Pokemon has no item, it finds one used by an adjacent Pokemon this turn.
Pickup.desc: At the end of each turn, if this Pokemon is not holding an item and at least one adjacent Pokemon used an item during this turn, one of those Pokemon is selected at random and this Pokemon obtains that Pokemon's last used item. An item is not considered the last used if it was a popped Air Balloon, if the item was picked up by another Pokemon with this Ability, or if the item was lost to Bug Bite, Corrosive Gas, Covet, Incinerate, Knock Off, Pluck, or Thief. Items thrown with Fling can be picked up.

Piercing Drill.short: This Pokemon's contact moves ignore a target's protection and deal 1/4 the usual damage.

Pixilate.short: This Pokemon's Normal-type moves become Fairy type and have 1.2× power.
Pixilate.desc: This Pokemon's Normal-type moves become Fairy-type moves and have their power multiplied by 1.2. This effect comes after other effects that change a move's type, but before Ion Deluge and Electrify's effects.

Plus.short: If an active ally has this Ability or the Minus Ability, this Pokemon's Sp. Atk is 1.5×.
Plus.desc: If an active ally has this Ability or the Minus Ability, this Pokemon's Special Attack is multiplied by 1.5.

Poison Heal.short: This Pokemon is healed by 1/8 of its max HP each turn when poisoned; no HP loss.
Poison Heal.desc: If this Pokemon is poisoned, it restores 1/8 of its maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn instead of losing HP.

Poison Point.short: 30% chance a Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon will be poisoned.

Poison Puppeteer.short: Pecharunt: If this Pokemon poisons a target, the target also becomes confused.
Poison Puppeteer.desc: If this Pokemon is a Pecharunt and poisons or badly poisons a target, the target also becomes confused.

Poison Touch.short: This Pokemon's contact moves have a 30% chance of poisoning.
Poison Touch.desc: This Pokemon's contact moves have a 30% chance of poisoning. This effect comes after a move's inherent secondary effect chance.

Power Construct.short: If Zygarde 10%/50%, changes to Complete if at 1/2 max HP or less at end of turn.
Power Construct.desc: If this Pokemon is a Zygarde in its 10% or 50% Forme, it changes to Complete Forme when it has 1/2 or less of its maximum HP at the end of the turn.

Power Spot.short: This Pokemon's allies have the power of their moves multiplied by 1.3.
Power Spot.desc: This Pokemon's allies have the power of their moves multiplied by 1.3. This affects Doom Desire and Future Sight, even if the user is not on the field.

Power of Alchemy.short: This Pokemon copies the Ability of an ally that faints.
Power of Alchemy.desc: This Pokemon copies the Ability of an ally that faints. Abilities that cannot be copied are As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Commander, Disguise, Embody Aspect, Flower Gift, Forecast, Hunger Switch, Ice Face, Illusion, Imposter, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Poison Puppeteer, Power Construct, Power of Alchemy, Protosynthesis, Quark Drive, Receiver, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shell, Tera Shift, Teraform Zero, Trace, Wonder Guard, Zen Mode, and Zero to Hero.

Prankster.short: This Pokemon's Status moves have priority raised by 1, but Dark types are immune.
Prankster.desc: This Pokemon's non-damaging moves have their priority increased by 1. Opposing Dark-type Pokemon are immune to these moves, and any move called by these moves, if the resulting user of the move has this Ability.

Pressure.short: If this Pokemon is the target of a foe's move, that move loses one additional PP.
Pressure.desc: If this Pokemon is the target of an opposing Pokemon's move, that move loses one additional PP. Imprison, Snatch, and Tera Blast also lose one additional PP when used by an opposing Pokemon, but Sticky Web does not.

Primordial Sea.short: On switch-in, heavy rain begins until this Ability is not active in battle.
Primordial Sea.desc: On switch-in, the weather becomes Heavy Rain, which includes all the effects of Rain and prevents damaging Fire-type moves from executing. This weather remains in effect until this Ability is no longer active for any Pokemon, or the weather is changed by the Delta Stream or Desolate Land Abilities.

Prism Armor.short: This Pokemon receives 3/4 damage from supereffective attacks.

Propeller Tail.short: This Pokemon's moves cannot be redirected to a different target by any effect.

Protean.short: This Pokemon's type changes to the type of the move it is using. Once per switch-in.
Protean.desc: This Pokemon's type changes to match the type of the move it is about to use. This effect comes after all effects that change a move's type. This effect can only happen once per switch-in, and only if this Pokemon is not Terastallized.

Protosynthesis.short: Sun active or Booster Energy used: highest stat is 1.3×, or 1.5× if Speed.
Protosynthesis.desc: If Sun is active or this Pokemon uses a held Booster Energy, this Pokemon's highest stat is multiplied by 1.3, or by 1.5 if the highest stat is Speed. Stat stage changes are considered at the time this Ability activates. If multiple stats are tied, Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed are prioritized in that order. If this effect was started by Sun, a held Booster Energy will not activate and the effect ends when Sun is no longer active. If this effect was started by a held Booster Energy, it ends when this Pokemon is no longer active.

Psychic Surge.short: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Psychic Terrain.

Punk Rock.short: This Pokemon receives 1/2 damage from sound moves. Its own have 1.3× power.
Punk Rock.desc: This Pokemon's sound-based moves have their power multiplied by 1.3. This Pokemon takes halved damage from sound-based moves.

Purifying Salt.short: Ghost damage to this Pokemon dealt with a halved offensive stat; can't be statused.
Purifying Salt.desc: This Pokemon cannot become affected by a non-volatile status condition or Yawn. If a Pokemon uses a Ghost-type attack against this Pokemon, that Pokemon's offensive stat is halved when calculating the damage to this Pokemon.

Quark Drive.short: Electric Terrain active or Booster Energy used: highest stat is 1.3×, or 1.5× if Speed.
Quark Drive.desc: If Electric Terrain is active or this Pokemon uses a held Booster Energy, this Pokemon's highest stat is multiplied by 1.3, or by 1.5 if the highest stat is Speed. Stat stage changes are considered at the time this Ability activates. If multiple stats are tied, Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed are prioritized in that order. If this effect was started by Electric Terrain, a held Booster Energy will not activate and the effect ends when Electric Terrain is no longer active. If this effect was started by a held Booster Energy, it ends when this Pokemon is no longer active.

Queenly Majesty.short: This Pokemon and its allies are protected from opposing priority moves.
Queenly Majesty.desc: Priority moves used by opposing Pokemon targeting this Pokemon or its allies are prevented from having an effect.

Quick Draw.short: This Pokemon has a 30% chance to move first in its priority bracket with attacking moves.

Quick Feet.short: If this Pokemon is statused, its Speed is 1.5×; ignores Speed drop from paralysis.
Quick Feet.desc: If this Pokemon has a non-volatile status condition, its Speed is multiplied by 1.5. This Pokemon ignores the paralysis effect of halving Speed.

RKS System.short: If this Pokemon is a Silvally, its type changes to match its held Memory.

Rain Dish.short: If Rain is active, this Pokemon heals 1/16 of its max HP each turn.
Rain Dish.desc: If Rain is active, this Pokemon restores 1/16 of its maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn. This effect is prevented if this Pokemon is holding a Utility Umbrella.

Rattled.short: Speed is raised 1 stage if hit by a Bug-, Dark-, or Ghost-type attack, or Intimidated.
Rattled.desc: This Pokemon's Speed is raised by 1 stage if hit by a Bug-, Dark-, or Ghost-type attack, or if an opposing Pokemon affected this Pokemon with the Intimidate Ability.

Rebound.short: On switch-in, blocks certain status moves and bounces them back to the user.
Rebound.desc: On switch-in, this Pokemon blocks certain status moves and instead uses the move against the original user.

Receiver.short: This Pokemon copies the Ability of an ally that faints.
Receiver.desc: This Pokemon copies the Ability of an ally that faints. Abilities that cannot be copied are As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Commander, Disguise, Embody Aspect, Flower Gift, Forecast, Hunger Switch, Ice Face, Illusion, Imposter, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Poison Puppeteer, Power Construct, Power of Alchemy, Protosynthesis, Quark Drive, Receiver, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shell, Tera Shift, Teraform Zero, Trace, Wonder Guard, Zen Mode, and Zero to Hero.

Reckless.short: This Pokemon's attacks with recoil or crash damage have 1.2× power; not Struggle.
Reckless.desc: This Pokemon's attacks with recoil or crash damage have their power multiplied by 1.2. Does not affect Struggle.

Refrigerate.short: This Pokemon's Normal-type moves become Ice type and have 1.2× power.
Refrigerate.desc: This Pokemon's Normal-type moves become Ice-type moves and have their power multiplied by 1.2. This effect comes after other effects that change a move's type, but before Ion Deluge and Electrify's effects.

Regenerator.short: This Pokemon restores 1/3 of its maximum HP, rounded down, when it switches out.

Ripen.short: When this Pokemon eats certain Berries, the effects are doubled.
Ripen.desc: When this Pokemon eats certain Berries, the effects are doubled. Berries that restore HP or PP have the amount doubled, Berries that raise stat stages have the amount doubled, Berries that halve damage taken quarter it instead, and a Jaboca Berry or Rowap Berry has the attacker lose 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down.

Rivalry.short: This Pokemon's attacks do 1.25× on same gender targets; 0.75× on opposite gender.
Rivalry.desc: This Pokemon's attacks have their power multiplied by 1.25 against targets of the same gender or multiplied by 0.75 against targets of the opposite gender. There is no modifier if either this Pokemon or the target is genderless.

Rock Head.short: This Pokemon does not take recoil damage besides Struggle/Life Orb/crash damage.
Rock Head.desc: This Pokemon does not take recoil damage, except Struggle. Does not affect Life Orb damage or crash damage.

Rocky Payload.short: This Pokemon's offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Rock-type attack.

Rough Skin.short: Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon lose 1/8 of their max HP.
Rough Skin.desc: Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon lose 1/8 of their maximum HP, rounded down.

Sand Force.short: This Pokemon's Ground/Rock/Steel attacks do 1.3× in Sandstorm; immunity to it.
Sand Force.desc: If Sandstorm is active, this Pokemon's Ground-, Rock-, and Steel-type attacks have their power multiplied by 1.3. This Pokemon takes no damage from Sandstorm.

Sand Rush.short: If Sandstorm is active, this Pokemon's Speed is doubled; immunity to Sandstorm.
Sand Rush.desc: If Sandstorm is active, this Pokemon's Speed is doubled. This Pokemon takes no damage from Sandstorm.

Sand Spit.short: When this Pokemon is hit by an attack, the effect of Sandstorm begins.

Sand Stream.short: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Sandstorm.

Sand Veil.short: If Sandstorm is active, this Pokemon's evasiveness is 1.25×; immunity to Sandstorm.
Sand Veil.desc: If Sandstorm is active, the accuracy of moves used against this Pokemon is multiplied by 0.8. This Pokemon takes no damage from Sandstorm.

Sap Sipper.short: This Pokemon's Attack is raised 1 stage if hit by a Grass move; Grass immunity.
Sap Sipper.desc: This Pokemon is immune to Grass-type moves and raises its Attack by 1 stage when hit by a Grass-type move.

Schooling.short: If user is Wishiwashi, changes to School Form if it has > 1/4 max HP, else Solo Form.
Schooling.desc: On switch-in, if this Pokemon is a Wishiwashi that is level 20 or above and has more than 1/4 of its maximum HP left, it changes to School Form. If it is in School Form and its HP drops to 1/4 of its maximum HP or less, it changes to Solo Form at the end of the turn. If it is in Solo Form and its HP is greater than 1/4 its maximum HP at the end of the turn, it changes to School Form.

Scrappy.short: Fighting, Normal moves hit Ghost. Immune to Intimidate.
Scrappy.desc: This Pokemon can hit Ghost types with Normal- and Fighting-type moves. This Pokemon is immune to the effect of the Intimidate Ability.

Screen Cleaner.short: On switch-in, the effects of Aurora Veil, Light Screen, and Reflect end for both sides.

Seed Sower.short: When this Pokemon is hit by an attack, the effect of Grassy Terrain begins.

Serene Grace.short: This Pokemon's moves have their secondary effect chance doubled.
Serene Grace.desc: This Pokemon's moves have their secondary effect chance doubled. This effect stacks with the Rainbow effect, except for secondary effects that cause the target to flinch.

Shadow Shield.short: If this Pokemon is at full HP, damage taken from attacks is halved.

Shadow Tag.short: Prevents foes from choosing to switch unless they also have this Ability.
Shadow Tag.desc: Prevents opposing Pokemon from choosing to switch out, unless they are holding a Shed Shell, are a Ghost type, or also have this Ability.

Sharpness.short: This Pokemon's slicing moves have their power multiplied by 1.5.

Shed Skin.short: This Pokemon has a 33% chance to have its status cured at the end of each turn.
Shed Skin.desc: This Pokemon has a 33% chance to have its non-volatile status condition cured at the end of each turn.

Sheer Force.short: This Pokemon's attacks with secondary effects have 1.3× power; nullifies the effects.
Sheer Force.desc: This Pokemon's attacks with secondary effects have their power multiplied by 1.3, but the secondary effects are removed. If a secondary effect was removed, it also removes the user's Life Orb recoil and Shell Bell recovery, and prevents the target's Anger Shell, Berserk, Color Change, Emergency Exit, Pickpocket, Wimp Out, Red Card, Eject Button, Kee Berry, and Maranga Berry from activating.

Shell Armor.short: This Pokemon cannot be struck by a critical hit.

Shield Dust.short: This Pokemon is not affected by the secondary effect of another Pokemon's attack.
Shield Dust.desc: This Pokemon is not affected by the secondary effect of another Pokemon's attack. Attacks with secondary effects that are prevented include those with a chance (even 100%) to paralyze, sleep, freeze, burn, poison, confuse, cause this Pokemon to flinch, cause this Pokemon's stat stages to be lowered, as well as Anchor Shot, Eerie Spell, Fling, Psychic Noise, Salt Cure, Spirit Shackle, Syrup Bomb, and Throat Chop. The effect of Sparkling Aria is prevented if this Pokemon is the only target. Secondary effects added by King's Rock, Razor Fang, and the Poison Touch, Stench, and Toxic Chain Abilities are also prevented against this Pokemon.

Shields Down.short: If Minior, switch-in/end of turn it changes to Core at 1/2 max HP or less, else Meteor.
Shields Down.desc: If this Pokemon is a Minior, it changes to its Core forme if it has 1/2 or less of its maximum HP, and changes to Meteor Form if it has more than 1/2 its maximum HP. This check is done on switch-in and at the end of each turn. While in its Meteor Form, it cannot become affected by a non-volatile status condition or Yawn.

Simple.short: When one of this Pokemon's stat stages is raised or lowered, the amount is doubled.

Skill Link.short: This Pokemon's multi-hit attacks always hit the maximum number of times.
Skill Link.desc: This Pokemon's multi-hit attacks always hit the maximum number of times. Triple Kick and Triple Axel do not check accuracy for the second and third hits.

Slow Start.short: On switch-in, this Pokemon's Attack and Speed are halved for 5 turns.

Slush Rush.short: If Snow is active, this Pokemon's Speed is doubled.

Sniper.short: If this Pokemon strikes with a critical hit, the damage is multiplied by 1.5.

Snow Cloak.short: If Snow is active, this Pokemon's evasiveness is 1.25×.
Snow Cloak.desc: If Snow is active, the accuracy of moves used against this Pokemon is multiplied by 0.8.

Snow Warning.short: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Snow.

Solar Power.short: If Sun is active, this Pokemon's Sp. Atk is 1.5×; loses 1/8 max HP per turn.
Solar Power.desc: If Sun is active, this Pokemon's Special Attack is multiplied by 1.5 and it loses 1/8 of its maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn. These effects are prevented if the Pokemon is holding a Utility Umbrella.

Solid Rock.short: This Pokemon receives 3/4 damage from supereffective attacks.

Soul-Heart.short: This Pokemon's Special Attack is raised by 1 stage when another Pokemon faints.

Soundproof.short: This Pokemon is immune to sound-based moves, unless it used the move.

Speed Boost.short: This Pokemon's Speed is raised 1 stage at the end of each full turn on the field.
Speed Boost.desc: This Pokemon's Speed is raised by 1 stage at the end of each full turn it has been on the field.

Spicy Spray.short: If this Pokemon is hit by an attack, the attacker becomes burned.

Stakeout.short: This Pokemon's offensive stat is doubled against a target that switched in this turn.

Stall.short: This Pokemon moves last among Pokemon using the same or greater priority moves.

Stalwart.short: This Pokemon's moves cannot be redirected to a different target by any effect.

Stamina.short: This Pokemon's Defense is raised by 1 stage after it is damaged by a move.

Stance Change.short: If Aegislash, changes Forme to Blade before attacks and Shield before King's Shield.
Stance Change.desc: If this Pokemon is an Aegislash, it changes to Blade Forme before using an attacking move, and changes to Shield Forme before using King's Shield.

Static.short: 30% chance a Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon will be paralyzed.

Steadfast.short: If this Pokemon flinches, its Speed is raised by 1 stage.

Steam Engine.short: This Pokemon's Speed is raised by 6 stages after it is damaged by Fire/Water moves.
Steam Engine.desc: This Pokemon's Speed is raised by 6 stages after it is damaged by a Fire- or Water-type move.

Steelworker.short: This Pokemon's offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Steel-type attack.

Steely Spirit.short: This Pokemon and its allies' Steel-type moves have their power multiplied by 1.5.
Steely Spirit.desc: This Pokemon and its allies' Steel-type moves have their power multiplied by 1.5. This affects Doom Desire even if the user is not on the field.

Stench.short: This Pokemon's attacks without a chance to flinch gain a 10% chance to flinch.
Stench.desc: This Pokemon's attacks without a chance to make the target flinch gain a 10% chance to make the target flinch.

Sticky Hold.short: This Pokemon cannot lose its held item due to another Pokemon's Ability or attack.
Sticky Hold.desc: This Pokemon cannot lose its held item due to another Pokemon's Ability or attack, unless the attack knocks out this Pokemon. A Sticky Barb will be transferred to other Pokemon regardless of this Ability.

Storm Drain.short: This Pokemon draws Water moves to itself to raise Sp. Atk by 1; Water immunity.
Storm Drain.desc: This Pokemon is immune to Water-type moves and raises its Special Attack by 1 stage when hit by a Water-type move. If this Pokemon is not the target of a single-target Water-type move used by another Pokemon, this Pokemon redirects that move to itself if it is within the range of that move. If multiple Pokemon could redirect with this Ability, it goes to the one with the highest Speed, or in the case of a tie to the one that has had this Ability active longer.

Strong Jaw.short: This Pokemon's bite-based attacks have 1.5× power. Bug Bite is not boosted.
Strong Jaw.desc: This Pokemon's bite-based attacks have their power multiplied by 1.5.

Sturdy.short: If this Pokemon is at full HP, it survives one hit with at least 1 HP. Immune to OHKO.
Sturdy.desc: If this Pokemon is at full HP, it survives one hit with at least 1 HP. OHKO moves fail when used against this Pokemon.

Suction Cups.short: This Pokemon cannot be forced to switch out by another Pokemon's attack or item.

Super Luck.short: This Pokemon's critical hit ratio is raised by 1 stage.

Supersweet Syrup.short: On switch-in, this Pokemon lowers the evasiveness of opponents 1 stage. Once per battle.

Supreme Overlord.short: This Pokemon's moves have 10% more power for each fainted ally, up to 5 allies.

Aeroblast.desc: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

Ancient Power.short: 10% chance to raise all stats by 1 (not acc/eva).

Apple Acid.short: 100% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 1.
Apple Acid.desc: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.

Aqua Cutter.desc: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

Aqua Ring.short: User recovers 1/16 max HP per turn.
Aqua Ring.desc: The user has 1/16 of its maximum HP, rounded down, restored at the end of each turn while it remains active. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3× normal, rounded half down. If the user uses Baton Pass, the replacement will receive the healing effect.

Aqua Step.short: 100% chance to raise the user's Speed by 1.
Aqua Step.desc: Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Speed by 1 stage.

Arm Thrust.desc: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move will hit 4-5 times.

Armor Cannon.short: Lowers the user's Defense and Sp. Def by 1.
Armor Cannon.desc: Lowers the user's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage.

Aromatherapy.short: Cures the user's party of all status conditions.
Aromatherapy.desc: Every Pokemon in the user's party is cured of its non-volatile status condition. Active Pokemon with the Sap Sipper Ability are not cured, unless they are the user.

Aromatic Mist.short: Raises an ally's Sp. Def by 1.
Aromatic Mist.desc: Raises the target's Special Defense by 1 stage. Fails if there is no ally adjacent to the user.

Assist.short: Uses a random move known by a team member.
Assist.desc: A random move among those known by the user's party members is selected for use. Does not select Assist, Baneful Bunker, Beak Blast, Belch, Bestow, Blazing Torque, Bounce, Celebrate, Chatter, Circle Throw, Combat Torque, Copycat, Counter, Covet, Destiny Bond, Detect, Dig, Dive, Dragon Tail, Endure, Feint, Fly, Focus Punch, Follow Me, Helping Hand, Hold Hands, King's Shield, Magical Torque, Mat Block, Me First, Metronome, Mimic, Mirror Coat, Mirror Move, Nature Power, Noxious Torque, Phantom Force, Protect, Rage Powder, Roar, Shadow Force, Shell Trap, Sketch, Sky Drop, Sleep Talk, Snatch, Spiky Shield, Spotlight, Struggle, Switcheroo, Tera Starstorm, Thief, Transform, Trick, Whirlwind, or Wicked Torque.

Assurance.short: Power doubles if target was damaged this turn.
Assurance.desc: Power doubles if the target has already taken damage this turn, other than direct damage from Belly Drum, confusion, Curse, or Pain Split.

Astonish.short: 30% chance to make the target flinch.
Astonish.desc: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.

Astral Barrage.short: No additional effect. Hits adjacent foes.

Attack Order.desc: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

Attract.short: A target of the opposite gender gets infatuated.
Attract.desc: Causes the target to become infatuated, making it unable to attack 50% of the time. Fails if both the user and the target are the same gender, if either is genderless, or if the target is already infatuated. The effect ends when either the user or the target is no longer active. Pokemon with the Oblivious Ability or protected by the Aroma Veil Ability are immune.

Aura Sphere.short: This move does not check accuracy.

Aura Wheel.desc: Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Speed by 1 stage. If the user is a Morpeko in Full Belly Mode, this move is Electric type. If the user is a Morpeko in Hangry Mode, this move is Dark type. This move cannot be used successfully unless the user's current form, while considering Transform, is Full Belly or Hangry Mode Morpeko.

Aurora Beam.short: 10% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1.
Aurora Beam.desc: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1 stage.

Aurora Veil.short: For 5 turns, damage to allies halved. Snow only.
Aurora Veil.desc: For 5 turns, the user and its party members take 0.5× damage from physical and special attacks, or 0.66× damage if in a Double Battle; does not reduce damage further with Reflect or Light Screen. Critical hits ignore this protection. It is removed from the user's side if the user or an ally is successfully hit by Brick Break, Psychic Fangs, or Defog. Brick Break and Psychic Fangs remove the effect before damage is calculated. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Light Clay. Fails unless the weather is Snow.

Autotomize.short: Raises the user's Speed by 2; user loses 100 kg.
Autotomize.desc: Raises the user's Speed by 2 stages. If the user's Speed was changed, the user's weight is reduced by 100 kg as long as it remains active. This effect is stackable but cannot reduce the user's weight to less than 0.1 kg.

Avalanche.short: Power doubles if user is damaged by the target.
Avalanche.desc: Power doubles if the user was hit by the target this turn.

Axe Kick.short: 30% confusion. User loses 50% max HP if miss.
Axe Kick.desc: Has a 30% chance to confuse the target. If this attack is not successful, the user loses half of its maximum HP, rounded down, as crash damage. Pokemon with the Magic Guard Ability are unaffected by crash damage.

Baby-Doll Eyes.desc: Lowers the target's Attack by 1 stage.

Baneful Bunker.desc: The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn, and Pokemon making contact with the user become poisoned. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.

Barb Barrage.short: 50% psn. 2× power if target already poisoned.
Barb Barrage.desc: Has a 50% chance to poison the target. Power doubles if the target is already poisoned.

Barrage.desc: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times.

Barrier.desc: Raises the user's Defense by 2 stages.

Baton Pass.short: User switches, passing stat changes and more.
Baton Pass.desc: The user is replaced with another Pokemon in its party. The selected Pokemon has the user's stat stage changes transferred to it, as well as the effects of confusion, Aqua Ring, Curse, Dragon Cheer, Embargo, Focus Energy, Gastro Acid, Heal Block, Ingrain, Leech Seed, Lock-On (Mind Reader), Magnet Rise, Perish Song, Power Trick, Telekinesis, and a substitute with its remaining HP. The effect of Gastro Acid is not transferred if the recipient has an Ability that cannot be affected.

Beak Blast.short: Burns on contact with the user before it moves.
Beak Blast.desc: If the user is hit by a contact move this turn before it can execute this move, the attacker is burned.

Beat Up.short: All healthy allies aid in damaging the target.
Beat Up.desc: Hits one time for the user and one time for each unfainted Pokemon without a non-volatile status condition in the user's party. The power of each hit is equal to 5+(X/10), where X is each participating Pokemon's base Attack; each hit is considered to come from the user.

Belch.short: Cannot be selected until the user eats a Berry.
Belch.desc: This move cannot be selected until the user eats a Berry, either by eating one that was held, stealing and eating one off another Pokemon with Bug Bite or Pluck, or eating one that was thrown at it with Fling. Once the condition is met, this move can be selected and used for the rest of the battle even if the user gains or uses another item or switches out. Consuming a Berry with Natural Gift does not count for the purposes of eating one.

Belly Drum.short: User loses 50% max HP. Maximizes Attack.
Belly Drum.desc: Raises the user's Attack by 12 stages in exchange for the user losing 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded down. Fails if the user would faint or if its Attack stat stage is 6.

Bestow.short: User passes its held item to the target.
Bestow.desc: The target receives the user's held item. Fails if the user has no item or is holding a Z-Crystal, if the target is already holding an item, if the item is a Mega Stone and either the user or the target is the species that can Mega Evolve with it, or if the item is a Blue Orb, Red Orb, Griseous Orb, Plate, Drive, or Memory and either the user or the target is a Kyogre, Groudon, Giratina, Arceus, Genesect, or Silvally, respectively.

Bide.short: Waits 2 turns; deals double the damage taken.
Bide.desc: The user spends two turns locked into this move and then, on the second turn after using this move, the user attacks the last Pokemon that hit it, inflicting double the damage in HP it lost to attacks during the two turns. If the last Pokemon that hit it is no longer active, the user attacks a random opposing Pokemon instead. If the user is prevented from moving during this move's use, the effect ends. This move does not check accuracy and does not ignore type immunity.

Bind.short: Traps and damages the target for 4-5 turns.
Bind.desc: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Shed Tail, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.

Bite.short: 30% chance to make the target flinch.
Bite.desc: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.

Bitter Blade.desc: The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3× normal, rounded half down.

Bitter Malice.desc: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1 stage.

Blast Burn.desc: If this move is successful, the user must recharge on the following turn and cannot select a move.

Blaze Kick.short: High critical hit ratio. 10% chance to burn.
Blaze Kick.desc: Has a 10% chance to burn the target and a higher chance for a critical hit.

Blazing Torque.desc: Has a 30% chance to burn the target.

Bleakwind Storm.short: 30% to lower foe(s) Speed by 1. Rain: can't miss.
Bleakwind Storm.desc: Has a 30% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage. If the weather is Heavy Rain or Rain, this move does not check accuracy. If this move is used against a Pokemon holding Utility Umbrella, this move's accuracy remains at 80%.

Blizzard.short: 10% chance to freeze foe(s). Can't miss in Snow.
Blizzard.desc: Has a 10% chance to freeze the target. If the weather is Snow, this move does not check accuracy.

Block.short: Prevents the target from switching out.
Block.desc: Prevents the target from switching out. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field.

Blood Moon.short: Cannot be selected the turn after it's used.

Bloom Doom.short: Power is equal to the base move's Z-Power.

Blue Flare.desc: Has a 20% chance to burn the target.

Body Press.short: Uses user's Def stat as Atk in damage calculation.
Body Press.desc: Damage is calculated using the user's Defense stat as its Attack, including stat stage changes. Other effects that modify the Attack stat are used as normal.

Body Slam.desc: Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target. Damage doubles and no accuracy check is done if the target has used Minimize while active.

Bolt Beak.short: Power doubles if user moves before the target.
Bolt Beak.desc: Power doubles if the user moves before the target.

Bolt Strike.desc: Has a 20% chance to paralyze the target.

Bone Club.short: 10% chance to make the target flinch.
Bone Club.desc: Has a 10% chance to make the target flinch.

If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move will hit 4-5 times.

Bonemerang.desc: Hits twice. If the first hit breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the second hit.

Boomburst.short: No additional effect. Hits adjacent Pokemon.

Bounce.desc: Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target. This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. On the first turn, the user avoids all attacks other than Gust, Hurricane, Sky Uppercut, Smack Down, Thousand Arrows, Thunder, and Twister, and Gust and Twister have doubled power when used against it. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.

Brave Bird.desc: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 33% the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.

Breaking Swipe.short: 100% chance to lower the foe(s) Attack by 1.
Breaking Swipe.desc: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1 stage.

Brick Break.desc: If this attack does not miss, the effects of Reflect, Light Screen, and Aurora Veil end for the target's side of the field before damage is calculated.

Brine.short: Power doubles if the target's HP is 50% or less.
Brine.desc: Power doubles if the target has less than or equal to half of its maximum HP remaining.

Brutal Swing.short: No additional effect. Hits adjacent Pokemon.

Bubble.short: 10% chance to lower the foe(s) Speed by 1.
Bubble.desc: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.

Bubble Beam.short: 10% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1.
Bubble Beam.desc: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.

Bug Bite.short: User steals and eats the target's Berry.
Bug Bite.desc: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, it steals the target's held Berry if it is holding one and eats it immediately, gaining its effects even if the user's item is being ignored. Items lost to this move cannot be regained with Recycle or the Harvest Ability.

Bug Buzz.short: 10% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 1.
Bug Buzz.desc: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.

Bulk Up.short: Raises the user's Attack and Defense by 1.
Bulk Up.desc: Raises the user's Attack and Defense by 1 stage.

Bulldoze.desc: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.

If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move will hit 4-5 times.

Burn Up.short: User's Fire type becomes typeless; must be Fire.
Burn Up.desc: Fails unless the user is a Fire type. If this move is successful and the user is not Terastallized, the user's Fire type becomes typeless as long as it remains active.

Burning Bulwark.short: Protects from damaging attacks. Contact: burn.
Burning Bulwark.desc: The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn, and Pokemon trying to make contact with the user become burned. Non-damaging moves go through this protection. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.

Burning Jealousy.short: 100% burns a target that had a stat rise this turn.
Burning Jealousy.desc: Has a 100% chance to burn the target if it had a stat stage raised this turn.

Calm Mind.short: Raises the user's Sp. Atk and Sp. Def by 1.
Calm Mind.desc: Raises the user's Special Attack and Special Defense by 1 stage.

Camouflage.short: Changes user's type by terrain (default Normal).
Camouflage.desc: The user's type changes based on the battle terrain. Normal type on the regular Wi-Fi terrain, Electric type during Electric Terrain, Fairy type during Misty Terrain, Grass type during Grassy Terrain, and Psychic type during Psychic Terrain. Fails if the user's type cannot be changed or if the user is already purely that type.

Captivate.short: Lowers the foe(s) Sp. Atk by 2 if opposite gender.
Captivate.desc: Lowers the target's Special Attack by 2 stages. The target is unaffected if both the user and the target are the same gender, or if either is genderless. Pokemon with the Oblivious Ability are immune.

Ceaseless Edge.short: Sets a layer of Spikes on the opposing side.
Ceaseless Edge.desc: If this move is successful, it sets up a hazard on the opposing side of the field, damaging each opposing Pokemon that switches in, unless it is a Flying-type Pokemon or has the Levitate Ability.
